note: Training data only. Alerts and IP addresses are illustrative.

alerts.reason: Repeated failed login attempts may indicate a brute-force attack.
alerts.recommendation: Review authentication logs, verify the source IP, and check for a successful login.

alerts.reason: A malware detection may indicate a compromised system.
alerts.recommendation: Follow incident response procedures and investigate or isolate the affected host according to policy.

alerts.reason: Unusual outbound traffic may indicate suspicious communication or data transfer.
alerts.recommendation: Review destination, volume, timing, and endpoint activity to determine whether the traffic is expected.

alerts.reason: An activity may have violated an internal security policy.
alerts.recommendation: Review the event and applicable policy to determine whether further investigation is required.

alerts.reason: No triage rule exists for this alert type.
alerts.recommendation: Review the alert manually and create an approved rule if appropriate.
